text:
incident-bot: PAGE: metering-alert - elevated token-count drift detected for production ingest.
mike: saw the alert - counts jumping ~8-12% vs baseline starting 1737012000. :eyes:
nina: confirming - tails of the windowed aggregator show duplicate keys around kafka-partition-7.
jamal: oncall taking. pinging billing-bot and support to check customer-facing flags.
billing-bot: @jamal Customers with overage flags: acct_9812, acct_4401, acct_7720. Flags emitted at 1737012302.
sara: are those real overages or false positives from the drift? we need to avoid emailing customers prematurely.
leo: quick triage - ingest emitter resumed after a transient OOM on vm-gpu-03 at 1737011995. Possible duplicate acks during restart.
mike: logs show replays with identical message_id but different offsets. snippet:
```
2024-04-12T21:06:10Z emitter INFO replay message_id=abcd1234 offset=452221 dup=true
```
ana_support: support team: we have one open ticket from acct_9812 reporting unexpected charges, created at 1737012400.
jamal: ok plan: 1) pause automated overage notifications (billing-bot -> suspend-notify), 2) re-run idempotency scrub job on windowed-agg, 3) hold invoice pipeline for affected accounts, 4) keep customers updated via #support.
nina: reproducing locally with a small stream - duplicate ACKs appear if emitter reconnects within 3s window. adding a dedupe-layer to the consumer.
sara: can we run the scrub for just the last 12 minutes to avoid heavy backfills?
mike: yes - runbook step: `scripts/scrub_window --start 1737011800 --end 1737012600 --dryrun` then review diff. if diffs consistent, apply.
jamal: executing dry run now. I'll paste results in 10m.
incident-bot: oncall-handoff scheduled -> jamal (30m). :page_facing_up:
leo: also routing note - enable fallback counting service (count-fallback-prod) to return stable deltas during scrub.
billing-bot: notifications suspended for accounts tagged: acct_9812, acct_4401, acct_7720, acct_9900 by request of oncall.
mike: dry run finished - scrub suggests ~9.7% of tokens in window are duplicate replays for stream id `ingest-main`. sample diff:
```
account acct_9812: tokens_before=1,002,322 tokens_after=905,011 delta=-97,311
```
ana_support: I'll draft a brief for sales/support: no billing adjustments yet, holding invoices while post-scrub reconciliation completes. ETA 45m for reconciliation run.
nina: mitigation note - adding a 2s ack-quarantine on emitter to prevent immediate replays; will ship a quick patch to staging.
jamal: rolling the quarantine change to prod on vm-gpu-03 only (canary) - watching for 5m.
sara: customer impact: low risk yet visible to 3 accounts. no broader SLA breach. send a proactive note to acct_9812 contact after reconciliation completes.
jamal: can someone open a tracking ticket with recon artifacts + root_cause hypothesis? suggest tags: metering, duplicate-acks, emitter-restart, pay-notify-hold.
leo: opened ticket RDW-3482 and attached dryrun output.
mike: follow-up: schedule postmortem if reconciler shows >1% net delta after scrubbing.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress. responders: jamal, nina, mike. next update expected ~1737013200.
